-- True when no value appears twice in xs.
all_distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    for j in range(i + 1, xs.len())
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
  True

-- Deterministic: the result depends only on n and seed, never on a clock,
-- randomness or any other capability.
make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  post all_distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
  ex make_ids(3, 7).len() == 3
  ex make_ids(3, 7) == make_ids(3, 7)
  var ids: List[int] = []
  let base = seed % 1000003
  for i in range(0, n)
    ids.append(base + i)
  ids

test_make_ids_empty() =
  assert make_ids(0, 1) == []

test_make_ids_same_seed() =
  assert make_ids(5, 42) == make_ids(5, 42)

test_make_ids_distinct() =
  assert all_distinct(make_ids(10, 3))
